description: Pick a recovery path per file and prove the outcome: read surviving plaintext, hunt copies in backups and snapshots, carve the raw device, rebuild WPS .osheet byte-exact, and on ext4 dig the jbd2 journal for pre-encryption content. 81 read-only scripts for Synology/Btrfs/ext4 NAS ransomware. 勒索数据分诊与交付工具箱。
